selection: MANAGED_CAPSULE entries in the verified snapshot. Repository provider catalogs are separate declared external-provider authority.

namespaceBindings.SCENARIO: owned by exact declared Capability identity
namespaceBindings.SCENARIO_INPUT: owned by exact declared Scenario identity
namespaceBindings.SCENARIO_EVENT: owned by exact declared Scenario identity
namespaceBindings.SCENARIO_OUTCOME: owned by exact declared Scenario identity
namespaceBindings.FIXTURE: owned by exact declared Capability identity
namespaceBindings.OBSERVABLE_CONDITION: owned by exact declared Capability identity

selectors.capability: Exact capability.authority.json entry; capabilityId must match verified capsule owner. No ID inferred from filename.
selectors.scenario: Feature @capability agrees with capsule authority. Exactly one explicit @scenario per scenario. Feature aliases with identical bytes count once. Duplicate/conflicting declarations stay unsupported.
selectors.scenarioFaces: Explicit @input, @event, @outcome tags only. Given/When/Then steps preserve declared responsibility and experience. Missing tags do not create IDs.
selectors.contracts: Exact contracts/contract-catalog.json ID keys and relative schema selectors. A locator resolves against the catalog entry root, then against the catalog's captured repository source path within the same capsule, because a capsule entry name is a packaging alias and a declared locator is relative to its document. Different IDs may share schema bytes.
selectors.ports: Explicit consumer-interface-authority.v1 portBindings[].portId declarations. platformCapabilityId is a Capability reference, never a Provider identity.
selectors.transformations: semantic-transformation.authority.json transformations[].id/expression. Preserve expression JSON structure; arbitrary properties never declare entities.
selectors.execution: execution-authorities.v1 executionAuthorities[].id/operations. invoke-port and invoke-scenario targets resolve in the same capsule. project-state resolves only when its projectionId is declared by the same capsule interface authority under sda-authority-state-projection.v1 and its configuration names an exact transformationId in that capsule transformation authority; any other projection form stays an observation.
selectors.fixtures: consumer-capability-fixtures.v1 fixtures[] are definitions. Explicit scenarioSequence, portOutcomes and assertion members are separate relationships. An assertion conditionId binds an observable condition only when that condition is declared by the capability owning the fixture; an unresolved conditionId is recorded as an unresolved reference, never invents a condition, and never invalidates the assertion literal test data.
selectors.providers: authority/cli/provider-catalog.json sfx-provider-catalog.v1 providers[].providerId. Candidate capabilities and command bindings remain declarations; neither is an implementation or qualification claim.

sharedLibrary: The agentic and feature-authoring shared execution authorities are bound once under their explicit shared namespaces before capsule scenarios, so a scenario event can resolve a shared authority it declares. A capsule-local declaration of the same ID takes precedence. Their operations remain members of the shared library mapping.
definitionManifest: Capability and legacy Scenario definitions include a sorted set of canonical semantic authority contributions from their declared capsule profile. Contributions are semantic JSON or parsed feature AST with parser locations/IDs removed. Exact finite fragment digests bind recursive scenario references without recursive derived-definition hashing. Source paths, capsule digests, source generation and import time are excluded.
sourceGaps: Historical blueprints, projected graphs/slots, carrier v2/v3, mechanic/profile declarations, projection authorities, proof evaluation and qualification profiles remain explicitly classified observations until their exact mapping is implemented. This initial profile makes no complete coverage or runtime readiness claim.
absence: Preserve absent, explicit null, unresolved and not applicable separately. Missing semantic identifiers never create entity rows.
lineage: Every normalized definition/member records exact source observations and canonical member locators under this rule. Repeated appearances add evidence, not identities.
coverage: One classification per source appearance under this rule. Unsupported semantic sources and sources outside the semantic declaration scope remain separately countable. Partial mappings carry findings and are not labeled wholly normalized.
